overview.about: The 3M Open is a mid-summer PGA Tour event at TPC Twin Cities in Blaine, just north of Minneapolis. A water-laden Arnold Palmer design, it offers plenty of risk-reward and typically produces low, exciting scoring.
overview.nextEvent: The next 3M Open is played at TPC Twin Cities in Minnesota. The generous but water-guarded layout invites aggressive play, and dramatic late birdies often decide it.

stayGuidance: A base in Blaine keeps the last leg to TPC Twin Cities shorter; Minneapolis and Saint Paul add more hotel choice with a longer transfer.
